notes: source.record.v1 (card AGGREGATES-V1) on source.buffer.v1. Three declared fields, one value constructed with three different numbers, all three read back and printed, then a second value of the same type read in a different order - a model that aliased two fields or a lowering that gave two fields one C member would print one value twice, so the per-stream byte comparison against the sanitized native run is a check of distinctness rather than a restatement of it. HONESTY BOUNDARY (AGGREGATE-CT09-LAYOUT): the ACCESS proof is supplied - construction totality, projection soundness and distinctness are checked, and the bad_field control refuses a read outside the declaration - but the LAYOUT leg is an executed sanitized byte-comparison OBSERVATION, not a proof. That a C compiler's designated initializer and member reads agree with the model is cross-checked by the comparison; nothing proves it, and the proof stage stays unassessed.

controls.note: Access: the identical program with one read renamed to a field the type does not declare. Refused at check time with the whole cascade pinned (the undeclared projection, then the binding it would have fed), so a field read is admitted only against the declaration it projects from.
